Class ChaosAssertions.CountAssert

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.testkit.ChaosAssertions.CountAssert
Enclosing class:
ChaosAssertions
public static final class ChaosAssertions.CountAssert extends Object
Assertions on a count. Without within(Duration) each one checks the count once. With within(t), atLeast(long) and exactly(long) wait up to t for the count to reach the bound, and atMost(long) and never() hold for the whole of t: they fail as soon as the count passes the bound.
